Audi Audi A3 / S3 (8V) (8V / 8V1, 2012-2020)

Updated 24 November 2026

Yes: VAG Scope supports the Audi A3 and S3 (8V, 2012-2020) over 11-bit CAN UDS completely offline, and includes an Audi S3 8V as a built-in demo car. Full scanning, mileage and VIN checks, Performance Hub timing, coding and adaptations work with no SFD lock.

Where is the OBD-II port?

Under the lower dash trim in the driver's footwell, left of the steering column above the bonnet lever.

Mileage & VIN check on this generation

MQB 11-bit UDS cars like the A3/S3 8V store distance across multiple independent units (engine, S-tronic, ABS, cluster, gateway) plus fault freeze frames, making pre-purchase verification thorough and quick. Agreement remains indicative only. Read the mileage check guide · VIN check guide

What to check before buying or maintaining

  • On S3 8V and quattro models, scan 22 All Wheel Drive (Haldex Gen 5) for pump motor faults, which frequently fail silently without triggering a dash warning light.
  • On 2.0 TFSI / S3 EA888 engines, monitor coolant temperature stability, boost pressure and ignition timing pull under load.
  • On S-tronic (DQ250, DQ381 or dry DQ200), read gearbox fault history and clutch/oil temperatures before hard test-drive pulls.
  • On 1.6 TDI and 2.0 TDI models, check DPF ash mass and SCR/AdBlue fault logs.

What VAG Scope supports on this chassis

Built-in demo car (Audi S3 8V, 11-bit UDS). Full offline diagnostics, mileage/VIN checks, Performance Hub timing and coding with zero SFD restrictions.

  • Pre-purchase health check: fault codes, cross-module mileage comparison and VIN check in one signed PDF report.
  • Full control-unit scan, advanced identification and fault clearing with automatic backup and confirmation.
  • Searchable live data (measuring blocks / UDS DIDs), 60-second charts, CSV logging and Android Auto dashboards.
  • Performance Hub: 0-500 km/h timing (100 Hz OBD + phone IMU fusion), virtual dyno and signed PNG/PDF proof cards without GPS permission.
  • Coding, long coding, gateway installation list, adaptations, basic settings, output tests and service reset with automatic backup and read-back.

Frequently asked questions

Can I preview the Audi S3 8V in VAG Scope right now?

Yes. An Audi S3 8V is built into the home screen as a demo car so you can explore UDS modules, coding, live charts and Performance Hub before buying an adapter.

Does VAG Scope detect a dead Haldex pump on an S3 8V?

Yes. Scanning unit 22 All Wheel Drive reveals Haldex pump electrical/mechanical faults and lets you run output tests on the pump.

Can I log 0-100 km/h and virtual dyno pulls on an S3 8V?

Yes. Performance Hub combines OBD vehicle speed with 100 Hz phone IMU data for centisecond timing, shift detection and virtual dyno curves, 100% offline.

Is SFD active on an A3 or S3 8V?

No. The 8V generation (2012-2020) has no SFD protection.
